import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/batch-751586af0e61e90c902c-contextual-000/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-final-full.json'))
p=d['payload']
for i,c in enumerate(p['bounded_context']):
    if i<2: continue
    head,_,rest=c['context'].partition('source_facts_v1:')
    print('==== R%d'%(i+1), head.strip())
    f=json.loads(rest)['fact']
    print(' evidence_status',f['evidence_status'],'missing',f['missing_evidence'])
    print(' main',f['main_source'].get('public_source_path'),f['main_source'].get('repository'),f['main_source'].get('commit'))
    print(' ph',f['placeholders'],f['placeholders_in_target'],f['placeholder_order_matches'])
    print(' term',json.dumps(f['terminology'],ensure_ascii=False))
    for a in f['anchors']:
        print(' anchor',a['kind'],a.get('public_source_path'),a.get('matching_lines'))
        for s in a.get('snippet',[]): print('   ',s['line'],'*' if s['is_match'] else ' ',s['text'])
"
